## Have you shipped 2+ projects in this vertical?

<!--
Vertical packs only ship after 2+ real shipped projects in the domain.
Otherwise they're speculation, not pattern.

If you've shipped 0-1: tell us about the project + we'll talk about
whether to wait OR co-build with you.

If you've shipped 2+: list them (even just internal names) so we can
calibrate.
-->

## Are you offering to co-build?

Custom packs (Enterprise tier) are co-built with the requesting customer
